verdict.rationale: The only openness evidence is Ramp's own docs calling its official Ramp CLI "open-source" and hosting it publicly at github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli, so a user can read source for that first-party client. The core Ramp platform (cards, bill pay, AI agents, MCP server, API backend) is a closed SaaS with no evidence of public source, and no license is named even for the CLI. Missing for 10: source for the core product, a named OSI-approved license, and independent confirmation of the CLI's licensing terms.
